## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-*juǎn* Pure Land devotional anthology compiled (*biān* 編) by the late-Qīng Hangzhou-area monk **[古崑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%A4%E5%B4%91) Gǔkūn lǎorén** 古崑老人 during the Tóngzhì 同治 / Guāngxù 光緒 reigns. The title — *suí xué* 隨學 ("studies pursued wherever one happens to be") — frames the work as a portable handbook for itinerant or busy practitioners, designed to support the practice of *niànfó* under any external circumstances.

**Abstract**

The opening *tící* 題詞 (titular verse-encomium) summarises the editorial conception: *Pópó* 娑婆 (this Sahā-world) is a sea of suffering; the Buddha's *xīfāng* gate is the unique compassionate deliverance; the Lúshān tradition of [慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) **Huìyuǎn**'s *Báiliánshè* 白蓮社 is the source of the Chinese Pure Land lineage; the present *zhèngfǎ* decline (*língyí* 陵夷) has produced widespread confusion that mistakes *wéixīn jìngtǔ* 唯心淨土 ("Pure Land as mind-only") for an annulment of the Western *xīfāng tǔ* — and Gǔkūn's anthology is offered as a *fǎyào* 法藥 (dharma-medicine) directed precisely at that confusion. The title verse explicitly cross-references the *Jìngtǔ shénzhū* 淨土神珠 [KR6p0117](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0117) as Gǔkūn's prior compilation in the same series.

The body of the anthology comprises substantial extracts from the standard Pure Land patristic and pastoral literature, organised thematically rather than chronologically: doctrinal extracts from the *Jìngtǔ sānjīng* 淨土三經 corpus, Tiāntái Zhìyǐ 智顗's *Shíyí lùn*, the **Yúnqī Zhūhóng** [袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F) / **Ǒuyì Zhìxù** late-Míng Pure Land tradition, the **Chèwù** [徹悟](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B9%E6%82%9F) / **Péng Jìqīng** [彭際清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BD%AD%E9%9A%9B%E6%B8%85) late-Qīng synthesis, and devotional verse. The work is one of the four short Gǔkūn anthologies preserved in the *Xùzàngjīng* 卍續藏 — alongside *Jìngtǔ bìqiú* [KR6p0107](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0107) (X1188), *Liánzōng bìdú* [KR6p0116](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0116) (X1197), and *Jìngtǔ shénzhū* [KR6p0117](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6p/KR6p0117) (X1198) — and shares with them the lay-pastoral, Hangzhou-regional register of late-Qīng popular Pure Land devotional scholarship.

The dating bracket adopted (1860–1890) covers Gǔkūn's principal active period.
